hero.h1: Lighting Control in Dallas Fort Worth
hero.sub: Keypads, scenes, and shades set around how you live, from one Dallas-Fort Worth team.

items.p: One engraved button sets the room: dinner, movie night, bedtime. Keypads go where the eye expects them.
Morning light at breakfast, candleglow at dinner, from the same fixture. Light that wakes you gently and lets you sleep.
Lights and shades follow a schedule, the daylight, or a touch on the app. Guests still get a switch that works.

about.p: TruDefinition designs, installs, programs, and supports integrated technology for new construction, renovations, and existing homes across Dallas-Fort Worth. You work directly with the people who design and install your system, with forty-plus years of combined experience behind every question we ask.

steps.p: We walk the home or the plans with you, set the priorities, and write down the constraints before a wire is drawn.
Keypad locations, loads, shade power, and equipment rooms go on the electrical and interior plans before rough-in.
Cabling and panels go in behind the finished surfaces. Every scene, keypad, and schedule is tested room by room.
We train the household, hand over the records, and adjust the programming as the home changes.
